title: John Rutledge House
geometryBasis: Named main-house envelope at 116 Broad Street and five exact October 2019 Qualla originals.
sectionBasis: Three stories and a raised basement, five bays, terra cotta window hoods, slate hip and two open tiers of blue-green cast iron.
limitations: The dated photographs control the front and west elevations, color and ironwork. The stepped rear roof and openings, chimney positions and other hidden details are estimates.
The ornamental ironwork reproduces the principal arched profiles, cast foliage and rail spacing at catalog scale. It simplifies individual cast motifs and the small porch furnishings.
The original terrain is unchanged, with approximate sidewalk and entry grade. The model scope is the main house and its street porch.
